name: @taskflow/tests
description: Explicit test gates for Resilient TaskFlow

scripts.test:api-runtime: pnpm --filter '@taskflow/api...' build && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://taskflow_test:taskflow_test@127.0.0.1:55459/taskflow_test REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:56399 REDIS_MAX_RETRIES=0 REDIS_RETRY_DELAY_MS=50 JWT_SECRET=taskflow-api-integration-secret-at-least-32-characters API_KEY_HASH_SALT=taskflow-api-integration-key-salt LOG_LEVEL=error vitest run integration/api-runtime.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:observability-integration: pnpm --filter '@taskflow/observability...' build && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://taskflow_test:taskflow_test@127.0.0.1:1/taskflow_test REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:1 REDIS_MAX_RETRIES=0 JWT_SECRET=taskflow-observability-integration-secret-32-characters API_KEY_HASH_SALT=taskflow-observability-integration-salt LOG_LEVEL=error vitest run integration/observability-otlp.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:worker-runtime: pnpm --filter '@taskflow/worker-app...' build && NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://taskflow_test:taskflow_test@127.0.0.1:55439/taskflow_test REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:56389 JWT_SECRET=taskflow-integration-secret-at-least-32-characters API_KEY_HASH_SALT=integration-test-salt LOG_LEVEL=error vitest run integration/worker-runtime.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts --reporter=verbose
